Package edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.frontend.view

Class FractalView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
javafx.scene.layout.Pane
javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane
edu.ntnu.stud.idatg2003.frontend.view.FractalView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ChaosGameObserver, javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
Direct Known Subclasses:
AffineTransformView, JuliaSetView
public abstract class FractalView extends javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane implements ChaosGameObserver
Abstract base class for all fractal views in the application. Provides common functionality for handling canvas, menus, and settings.
Since:
0.0.3 (The version of Chaos-Game application when introduced)
